description:
Atmosphere in Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral in Florence, Italy (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
Here I’m sitting in the beautiful and famous Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral (in Florence, Italy), and one can hear hundreds of tourists passing by, walking around, while whispering or talking. 
Recorded in April 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).
